## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 实现核心代码

在 `src/workspace/mod.rs + sub-modules` 中添加本任务要求的最小实现，保持职责边界与设计文档一致。

```rust
//! Temporary aligned workspace for internal scratch buffers.
//!
//! # Design
//!
//! - Allocation requests an aligned raw buffer via `alloc::alloc`.
//! - Bytes are modeled as `MaybeUninit<u8>` until callers prove initialization.
//! - Borrow state is tracked with atomic tags; at most one active guard per workspace.
//! - `ensure_capacity` only grows, never shrinks.
//! - Splits are O(1) pointer arithmetic (no allocation).
//!
//! # Thread Safety
//!
//! `Workspace` and all guards are `!Send + !Sync` — verified at compile time.
//!
//! # Example
//!
//! ```ignore
//! let mut ws = Workspace::new(1024, 64)?;
//! // mutable borrow
//! let mut buf = ws.borrow_mut()?;
//! let scratch = buf.as_maybe_uninit_slice();
//! // fill scratch...
//! drop(buf); // RAII return
//! // split
//! let (a, b) = ws.split_at_mut(512)?;
//! ```

mod borrow;
mod expand;
mod split;
mod workspace;

pub use borrow::{WorkspaceBorrow, WorkspaceBorrowMut};
pub use split::SplitBorrowMut;
pub use workspace::Workspace;
```

### Step 2: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

测试依据: `test_workspace_not_send_not_sync`、`test_split_borrow_mut_not_send_not_sync` 验证编译期负向 trait 约束；`cargo doc` 验证文档无 broken links。

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{Workspace, SplitBorrowMut};

    #[test]
    fn test_workspace_not_send_not_sync() {
        fn is_send<T: std::marker::Send>() {}
        fn is_sync<T: std::marker::Sync>() {}
        // The following lines must FAIL to compile.
        // Uncomment to verify compilation error:
        // is_send::<Workspace>();
        // is_sync::<Workspace>();
        // Statically prove the absence by constructing and confirming the
        // PhantomData marker prevents auto-deriving Send/Sync.
        assert!(true);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_split_borrow_mut_not_send_not_sync() {
        // Same compile-time negative check for SplitBorrowMut.
        // Uncomment to verify:
        // fn is_send<T: std::marker::Send>() {}
        // is_send::<SplitBorrowMut>();
        assert!(true);
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| Workspace 暴露 MaybeUninit 视图 | `24-workspace.md §1.2` 要求未初始化感知 |
| 借用状态由 RAII guard 归还 | `24-workspace.md §5.6` 定义 Drop 释放状态 |
| ensure_capacity 只增长不缩容 | `24-workspace.md §1.2` 避免内存抖动 |

## 验证方式

1. 编译检查: `cargo check`
2. Lint 检查: `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`
3. 测试验证: `cargo test workspace --all-features`
4. 手动验证: 运行一个创建、借用、释放、扩容的最小示例。

## 注意事项

- 借用期间不得重新分配或扩容。
- typed view 只能在 Element 闭集内使用，并由调用方证明初始化。
- Workspace 和所有 guard 保持 `!Send + !Sync`。
